title: GatehouseDefs
description: Shared definitions for all Gatehouse KY-A contracts. Frozen at contracts-v1.

Did.description: Decentralized identifier. did:cid is admitted (content-addressed identity document; resolution is re-derivation).

Sha256Hex.description: Lowercase hex sha256 over canonical bytes (recursive sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8).

GenesisHash.description: The priorHash of the first event in a chain.

ForceName.description: The four forces of tetrahedral sovereignty.

SigmaPair.description: Pairwise separation coefficient index: s=Protect(Swordsman), m=Project(Mage), r=Reflect, c=Connect.

Stratum.description: Popcount of the 6 sovereignty bits. Strata sizes 1,6,15,20,15,6,1.

Vertex.description: Vertex of the 64-vertex Boolean sovereignty lattice {0,1}^6.

Bits6.description: The 6 sovereignty bits MSB-first in canonical dimension order (Protection, Delegation, Memory, Connection, Computation, Value).

Verdict.description: Harness verdict lexicon. Never a third vocabulary.

EvidenceKind.description: How a probe was answered: declared (self-attested), witnessed (observed by supervisor tooling), deep (verified end-to-end).

WitnessDraw.description: The Gap witness-draw record: deep-verification probes sampled deterministically from the sha256 of the agent's own canonicalised submission. Anti-grooming; re-derivable by an auditor.
